name: Karenu Kuro Bara
source:
Yaneko is a schoolgirl who isn't very smart.
She has to start taking supplementary lessons from the strict and scary veteran middle aged teacher Zaijouin.
Through the time spent together, they grow closer but...

[Translated from [url=http://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_085473zero/]DMM[/url]]
translation:
弥猫是一名不太聪明的女高中生。她必须开始接受严格可怕的中年资深教师斋藏院的补习。

在相处的日子里，两人的距离逐渐拉近，可是……

[翻译自[url=http://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_085473zero/]DMM[/url]]
